tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༈rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥrnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol zhes bya ba de nyid rang dang gzhan dang 'jig rte
༈rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥrnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol zhes bya ba de nyid rang dang gzhan dang 'jig rte

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol zhes bya ba de nyid rang dang gzhan dang 'jig rten gyi snang ba la mngon par skyo bas o rgyan rdzong gi gnas su gros 'debs mgur du bzhengs pa/ thugs rje mchog gi ye shes gru chen gyis/ /ma lus 'gro kun srid mtsho mthar 'byin zhing*/ /zhi ba rdul bral rin chen gling son pa'i/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho shin tu brgal dka'i gnas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa can/ /thar dka' gting mtha' med pa 'dir 'khyams pa'i/ /rmongs pa khyod la snying nas gros shig 'debs/ /gros 'di mtshang nas brus te ma btab na/ /kun spyod ngan pa 'di la 'dor dus med/ /blo 'di nang du ldog ste ma bltas na/ /rang skyon ngan pa 'di la thon dus med/ /de bas da res snying nas gros shig 'debs/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag yin no sems la zhog /dben par gnas kyang gzhan dang bsten 'dris mang*/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng chos brgyad ma bral bar/ /rang don 'chal ba'i gzhan don ltar snang can/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /sngon gyi rgyal bas byang chub brnyes pa dang*/ /chos mdzad gong mas grub pa brnyes pa yang*/ / dben par gnas te khyod ni rnam par g.yengs/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /zang zing rnyed bkur nor rdzas sgyu ma kun/ /sgrub la bar gcod bslu bar ma shes pas/ / gcig nas blangs shing gcig tu byin pa bzhin/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /sna tshogs skye bo du ma'i 'du long kun/ /'du 'dzi 'khrul pa'i bdud du ma shes par/ /kha lta chos bshad gzhan don byas so snyam/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /gar 'gro cha med gcig tu ma nges pas/ /nor rdzas gsog brun gnas kyi mkhar las sogs/ /rtag tu sdod rtsis 'khrul snang bden par 'dzin/

/'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /rang gi sems kyang mi thul mi zin par/ /gzhan sems thul zhing zin du re ba'i mi/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gze re rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /snying po'i de nyid nam yang mi sgrub par/ /tshe 'di lhur len nyin mtshan 'khrul pas 'da'/ /mdo med col chung dam pas bzhad gad gnas/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /don med skye bo mang po'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /gcig gis gcig 'ching dpon slob rnam g.yeng can/ /don med gzhi rten mgron khang gnyer ba'i tshul/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /nam yang mi stongs sgyu ma'i 'khrul snang la/ / dga' bder zhen nas thar lam byang chub stor/ /'khor ba'i gnas la cung zad mi skyo bar/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /da lo 'dug sa me mo phag lo nas/ /bcu gnyis lo nas sa pho lcags khyi ste/ /mtha' dmag lung bstan 'bros par mi brtson par/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bas 'dug gam soms/ /phyogs rnams kun nas dmag dang 'khrug long rgyas/ /skye bo mi srun sna tshogs 'tshe ba mang*/ /sbas yul rin chen tshol bar mi brtson par/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bas 'dug gam soms/ /rtag tu zol med phan pa ci bsgrubs kyang*/ /phyi nang kun tu yin pa'i skabs med pas/ /don med gzhi rten sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /ri ngogs bsten yang sa mtha' grong 'dabs bzhin/ /du ma 'du zhing 'brel 'dris dpag tu med/ /rnam par g.yel zhing brel do rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /tshe 'di blo yis btang yang mi thong la/ / bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa bshig kyang mi zhig cing/ /ri ngogs bsten kyang dben pa'i skabs med pa/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/

/dgos med tshig tu 'chad kyang zas gos gnyer/ /tshe 'di mi rtag zer yang 'chi ma dran/ /dben par sgrub la zhugs kyang 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /'jig rten 'khrul pa zer yang chos brgyad gnyer/ /'khrul snang don med zer yang bya byed mang*/ /thams cad mnyam nyid zer yang phyogs ris bskyangs/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /gnas lugs bsgrub par zhugs kyang tshe 'dis bslus/ /rang dbang chos la spyod kyang gzhan dbang bslus/ /ji ltar byas kyang nyin mtshan 'khrul pas bslus/ /'di 'dra'i spyod pas yong bar 'dug gam soms/ /gang la bsams kyang snying po 'ga' med la/ /ji ltar byas kyang don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /thams cad spangs la mi med lung stong du/ /de ring nyid nas phyin par gyur na legs/ /rang bas rang la nye ba 'ga' med pas/ /phan pa'i kha ta sha tsha'i gros 'debs la/ /thar pa 'dod pa dge ba'i sems khyod nyon/ /gros 'di nyan na rtag tu dge ba lags/ /thog mar dge ba tshe 'di'i bya ba thong*/ /bar du dge ba dben par 'du 'dzi skyungs/ /tha mar dge ba gnas lugs zad sar skyol/ /'dir bde phyi mar skyid pa'i gros 'dun lags/ /gros 'di rang gis rang la btab pa ste/ /gzhan la'ang bskul phyir gdams pa'i gros 'di la/ / rang gzhan kun gyis legs par gsan par mdzod/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res 'grub pa lags/ /rang la gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur las/ rang skyon ngan pa mtshangs nas 'don pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //yang de nyid kyi dus su rang gzhan gyi snang ba dang tshe 'di'i bya ba la nges 'byung dang skyo shas drag po skyes nas bslab bya mgur du gsungs so/ / thog mtha' med pa kun gzhi'i thang chen du/ /ma rig skye bo gzung 'dzin rkang 'khyams te/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal non pa yis/ /nongs pa khyod la da dung gros shig 'debs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di la ma bsams na/

/nges 'byung skyo shas 'di la skye dus med/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'di la ma bsams na/ /spro dga'i dam chos 'di la 'ong dus med/ / rtag tu 'chi ba 'di la ma bsams na/ /snying nas lha chos 'di la 'ong dus med/ /thar pa'i phan yon 'di la ma bsams na/ /bla med byang chub 'di la 'grub dus med/ /dkar nag dge sdig rgyu 'bras ma bsams na/ /chos dang chos min blang dor shes dus med/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu ma bor na/ /phyi ma'i dam chos 'di la 'grub dus med/ /snying nas dgos med rgyud la ma skyes na/ /rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi 'di la spang dus med/ /mthun 'jug rtsig pa rming nas ma bsgyel na/ /'brel 'dris gzhan sems 'di la zin dus med/ /'khrul pa'i bya byed cog gis ma bzhag na/ /nyin mtshan brel do 'di la zin dus med/ /rtag tu khas nyen dma' sa ma bzung na/ / rang rgyud ngan pa 'di la thul dus med/ /bzod pa'i sman gyis khong khro ma btul na/ /zhe sdang zug rngu 'di la zhi dus med/ /dge sdig las la gso sbyong ma byas na/ /spong gnyen lam khyer 'di la 'grub dus med/ /byas pa thams cad don med ma rtogs na/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul snang 'di las ldog dus med/ /ngar 'dzin ri bo rming nas ma bsgyel na/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa 'di la 'jig dus med/ /nges 'byung skyo shas gting nas ma skyes na/ /thar lam dam chos 'di la 'ong dus med/ /ngo srung 'brel 'dris 'khri ba ma bcad na/ /dben par dam chos 'di la 'grub dus med/ /byams dang snying rjes rang rgyud ma brlan na/ /theg chen lam bzang 'di la bgrod dus med/ /sbyin sogs dge ba ci 'grub ma byas na/ /thar lam byang chub 'di la phyin dus med/ /mi dge'i sdig la 'dzem par ma byas na/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di las log dus med/ /gcig pur dben pa ri khrod ma bsten na/ /snying po'i dam chos 'di la 'grub dus med/ / dka' thub sdug bsran snying rus ma bskyed na/

/tshe gang legs pa'i chos mgo thon dus med/ /zhe bcad dam bca' brtan par ma byas na/ /sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub thob dus med/ /gnas lugs ngang la brtson par ma sgoms na/ /chos nyid rig pa'i gtan srid zin dus med/ /da res tshe 'dir thar lam ma snyogs na/ /rtag tu 'khor ba'i gnas las thar dus med/ /snying nas mos gus gsol ba ma btab na/ /gong ma'i byin rlabs rtogs pa 'char dus med/ /ltem rkyang med pa'i mos gus ma byas na/ /byin rlabs dngos grub bla ma mnyes dus med/ /sems la zol med dge ba ma 'bad na/ /gnas lugs sa zin dam chos 'grub dus med/ /rang skyon ngan pa mtshang nas ma phyung na/ /thabs dang gnyen po'i dam chos 'grub dus med/ /gong ma'i rjes su sgrub la ma 'brangs na/ /rang nyid dam pa'i gnas su phyin dus med/ /de bas tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /thar pa dam pa'i chos la 'bad par mdzod/ /gros 'di snying nas yin gyis gus pas nyon/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs 'tshal lo/ /gcig tu dge ba nges 'byung skyo shas skyed/ /gnyis su dge ba tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /gsum du dge ba dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs/ /chos sku rgyal po'i gtan srid zin pa lags/ /rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur las/ snang ba chos su bsgyur ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //yang de nyid kyi dus su rang gzhan tshe 'di'i bya byed 'khrul snang 'jig rten gyi bya ba la mngon par skyo bas phan med don gyi skul 'debs mgur du gsungs pa/ thog med goms pa bag chags ri bo la/ /ma rig gzung 'dzin drwa bas 'od gsal g.yogs/ /'khor ba'i gnas su cung zad mi skyo bas/ /yang 'dir rmongs pa khyod la gros shig 'debs/ /tshe 'di mi rtag bslu bar ma shes na/ /bsam gzhig thong bas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /thar pa'i lam sna da res ma zin na/ /mi lus thob pas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /dge sdig las la gso sbyong ma byas na/

/chos sgor zhugs los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal ma dran na/ /chos la spyod los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /tshe 'di dgos med snying nas ma dran na/ /bsod nams che los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /chog shes dgos med rgyud la ma skyes na/ / 'dod pa chung los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /dul ba'i sems kyis dma' sa ma bzung na/ /bzod pa sgom los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /khong khro nga rgyal nang nas ma btul na/ /bcos ma'i dul los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rang rgyud khong nas chos dang ma 'dres na/ /mdo rgyud shes los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /snying nas tshad med sems bskyed ma 'byongs na/ /theg chen yin los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /sdom pa dam tshig rnam dag ma bsrungs na/ / gsang sngags yin los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /skyo shas drag pos skul rkyen ma btab na/ /dben par sgrub los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /dngos 'dzin zhen pa gting nas ma log na/ /chos pa bzang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rang sems zol med dpang du ma btsugs na/ /gzhan ngor bzang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zhen pa ma log na/ / ngo mtshar che los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /bsod nams grags 'dod 'du 'dzi ma spangs na/ /'khor tshogs mang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /grags 'dod rlom sems phyogs 'dzin ma spangs na/ /gzhan phan che los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /phyogs ris bdag lta ngar 'dzin ma spangs na/ /gtong phod che los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rang 'dod zad pa'i phan sems mi ldan na/ /gzhan don byed los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /chos dang bla ma'i ngo mtshar ma dran na/ /bcos ma'i dad los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /gting nas rang la nges shes ma skyes na/ /gzhan gyi kha tas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /nang nas nyon mongs dgra ru ma mthong na/ /gzhan rkyen gnyen pos phan pa mi gda' lags/ /nges 'byung skyo shas 'chi ba ma dran na/ /byang chub sgrub los phan pa mi gda' lags/

/gcig pur nyams len gcig la ma dril na/ /thos bsam byas los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /zhen log skyo shas blo sna ma bstungs na/ /gcig pur sgom los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /mtshan ldan dam pa'i bla ma ma mjal na/ /bshes gnyen bsten los phan pa mi gda' lags/ / tshad med mos gus snying nas ma skyes na/ /bla ma bsten los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la ma zhugs na/ /thar lam sgrub los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa ma nus na/ /yin lugs shes los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /kha zhe med pa'i dag snang ma skyes na/ /mos gus che los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /snying nas mos gus sri zhu mi ldan na/ /mched la gus los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rang rig goms pa'i nyams myong ma skyes na/ /man ngag bzang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i gding tshad mi ldan na/ /go spyi'i lta bas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /btang bzhag med pa'i bsam gtan ma shes na/ /dmigs gtad sgom los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rang snang yul med stong par ma shes na/ /gnyis med spyod pas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rig stong zang thal chos skur ma rtogs na/ /'bras bu sgrub los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /sems la gang phan gnyen po ma bsten na/ /go yul kha ltas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /ma spangs rang yal dbyings su ma dag na/ /bzang rtog nying 'khrul phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rtog ngan 'bur 'joms dug lnga ma dag na/ /byar med stong pas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gding tshad mi ldan na/ /gnas chen 'grim los phan pa mi gda' lags/ / blo zad rjen pa'i gnas lugs ma rtogs na/ /rtogs ldan yin los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /rig stong bar med rang gnas ma shes na/ /sgom chen yin los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /phyi nang yul med zang thal ma rtogs na/ / sems ngo 'phrod los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /thams cad blos btang zhen log ma skyes na/ /gcig pur sgom los phan pa mi gda' lags/

/sdug dogs phyi tshis re dogs ma spangs na/ /lta dgongs mtho los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /kun spyod zhib mos rang rgyud ma btul na/ /grol lo zhig pos phan pa mi gda' lags/ /mi med lung stong 'grim par ma byas na/ /mtshams dang dam bcas phan pa mi gda' lags/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma rlung la ma bskur na/ /chos pa bzang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /ming dang gzugs kyi pho zo ma bshig na/ /bla ma bzang los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /'khor 'dabs 'brel 'dris rnam g.yeng ma spangs na/ /kun gyis bstod los phan pa mi gda' lags/ /de bas da res gong ma'i rjes bsnyags te/ /thar lam sgrub la brtson pa'i dus la babs/ /gros 'di snying nas 'debs kyi legs par nyon/ /sems 'di nang du ltos dang bden par mchi/ /dang por dge ba 'khor ba rgyab tu bor/ /bar du dge ba dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa bshig /tha mar dge ba rig pa'i gtan yul zungs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa lags/ /rang la gros su btab pa rdo rje'i mgur las tshe 'dir zhen pa log pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //yang de nyid kyi dus su 'khor dang rnam par g.yeng ba'i gnas la mngon par skyo bas gros 'debs mgur du gsungs pa/ /sngon nas legs par sbyangs pa'i 'phro sad pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal gyur cing*/ /zab don snying po'i gdams pa thob gyur kyang*/ /le los g.yengs pa khyod la gros shig 'debs/ /'gro drug nang nas mi yi lus rnyed dkon/ /de bas dam chos spyod pa'i lus rnyed dkon/ /brgya lam res 'ga' dal 'byor rnyed dus 'dir/ / gcig pur byang chub bsgrub na mi legs sam/ /tshe yang yun thung skad cig re res 'grib/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa rnams kyang 'bral/ /mthon po rgud cing bsags pa'i mtha' yang 'dzad/ /gcig pur zhi ba bsgrub na mi legs sam/ /'khor dang longs spyod nye bar 'brel ba'i gnyen/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba ma lus cis kyang 'dor/

/de bas da lta zhi ba'i nags khrod du/ /gcig pur dben par gnas na mi legs sam/ /bya ba'i las la zin pa'i go skabs med/ / gcig zin rjes la brel do de yis mang*/ /de bas bya byed 'khrul pa cog bzhag la/ /gcig pur sgrub la brtson na mi legs sam/ /'du 'dzi gzhan don sgrub la bslu ba'i bdud/ /ngo mtshar snyan grags bar chad 'ching ba'i gnas/ /zang zing nor rdzas sems chags nyon mongs gzhi/ /de bas sgrub la brtson na mi legs sam/ /don med 'khor tshogs kha 'dzin 'ching ba'i gnas/ /gcig gis gcig khrid rnam g.yeng rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bas thag ring mi med lung stong du/ / snying po'i don la brtson na mi legs sam/ /'jig rten skye bo bzod dka' mi srun pa/ / dus ngan gdul dka' shin tu ma rungs pa/ /snying po'i dam chos nam yang mi 'byung gi /dben par 'chi chos sgrub na mi legs sam/ /yin lugs bstan kyang sgrub par byed mkhan su/ /phan pas bskyangs kyang chos bzhin byed pa gang*/ /sha tshas bslabs kyang legs par nyan mkhan ci/ /dben par dam chos sgrub na mi legs sam/ /da rung 'dug kyang sngon bzhin skyo ba 'phel/ / ji ltar byas kyang don du 'gyur ba dka'/ /gang ltar bstan kyang de ltar rtogs pa nyung*/ /mi med lung stong 'grim na mi legs sam/ /dus ngan skye bo shin tu gdul dka' la/ /don med 'khor gyi log sgrub bzod par dka'/ /rang nyid ngal zhing gzhan la mi phan pas/ /gcig pur dben par phyin na mi legs sam/ /gros 'di snying nas yin gyis gus pas nyon/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spongs dang bde mo mchi/ /mi med lung stong 'grim dang mngon du 'gyur/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag yin gyis snying la zungs/ /gcig tu dge ba rang yul zhen pa btang*/ /gnyis su dge ba phyogs med ri khrod 'grim/ / gsum du dge ba sdug sran brtson 'grus bskyed/ /gnas lugs don la btsan sa zin pa lags/ / rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur las/

chags zhen 'khri ba bcad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //yang de nyid dus gang la'ang snying po med par mthong nas/ /gcig pur sgrub la brtson pa'i mgur gsungs pa/ /ma rig nam mkha' bzhin du rgya che la/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan mo'i mun rum shin tu nag/ /mi shes nyon mongs thog mtha' bar med pas/ /rmongs pa khyod la da rung gros shig 'debs/ /da res tshe 'dir thar lam snyegs bzhin du/ /sgrub la mi brtson rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ /'khrul snang tshe 'di'i bya bas ci byar yod/ /da res snying po'i don la sgrub par 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i dga' bde rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /cis kyang mi phan nges par 'dor nas 'gro/ /zas nor 'byor bas bdag la ci byar yod/ /da res zab don chos la sgrub par 'tshal/ /'dus kyang 'bral te tshong khang mgron po 'dra/ /gcig gis gcig 'ching mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /'khor 'dabs mang pos bdag la ci byar yod/ /da res 'bral med don la sgrub par 'tshal/ /ngo mtshar snyan grags bstod bkur rmi lam 'dra/ /'khrul pas byis pa bslu zhing blo sems 'phel/ /gzhan gyi bkur sti sri zhus ci byar yod/ /da res 'od gsal don la sgrub par 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba gang dang ci yang rung*/ / byas pa don med thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bya byed 'khrul pas bdag la ci byar yod/ /da res byar med don la sgrub par 'tshal/ /kun gyi nang nas gcig pur 'gro dus na/ /gang dang cis kyang phan pa cung zad med/ /tshe 'di'i snang bas bdag la ci byar yod/ /gros mo che la phan pa sgrub par 'tshal/ /su nye ci 'byor gang dang ci yod kyang*/ /rjes su 'brang ba dge sdig gnyis las med/ /gnyen bshes nor rdzas mang pas ci byar yod/ /skyas mo che la phan pa'i dam chos 'tshal/ /phyi rol yul la bde skyid grangs mang zhing*/ /lus sems dga' bde'i snang ba rgya che yang*/ /'chi ba'i dus na bdag la ci byar yod/ /bems rig bral dus phan pa'i gding zhig 'tshal/

/na yang mi 'tsher shi yang mi 'gyod la/ /'chi kar mi 'gyod zab don snying po'i chos/ /rang rig goms pa'i chos nyid nam mkha' la/ /gnas lugs don gyi btsan sa zin par 'tshal/ /yang 'khor yang skye gtan du mi khom pas/ /da res tshe 'dir chos nyid sa bzung nas/ /chos sku mi 'gyur gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rang rig chos sku'i go 'phang thob par 'tshal/ /gros 'di snying nas yin gyis gus pas nyon/ /gcig pur sgrub la brtson dang dngos grub 'byung*/ /rig pa'i ngang la skyongs dang nges shes skye/ /zab don gnad kyi man ngag dril ba lags/ /bdag gi sems 'di rnam g.yeng la skyo bas/ /gcig pur zhi ba sgrub la mos pa'i phyir/ /rang la gros su gdams pa'i rim pa 'di/ /skal bzang rnams kyi'ang snyan du phul ba lags/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag blo zhi ba'i tshal/ /zab gter yon tan 'byor pas yongs gang zhing*/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen sgo bzhi 'byed par shog/rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur las/ snying nas sgrub la skul pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //rang la grol su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ o rgyan rdzong gi gnas kun tu bzang po'i khang bzang zla ba chu shel gyis 'tsher ba'i gnas su smras so/ /shubhaṃ/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) rang la gros su gdams pa rdo rje'i mgur/ -PAGE 342--PAGE 353--PAGE 341-
